## What you’ll find here
- **Purpose:** Predictive modeling examples that complement classical biostatistics
- **Traceability:** Feature definitions → preprocessing → training/validation → outputs
- **Typical outputs:** ROC/PR curves, calibration, performance table, key drivers/importance

## Workflow (review-ready)
- **Inputs:** Subject-level or visit-level analysis dataset (ADaM-ready or analysis-ready)
- **Preprocessing:** Missingness handling, encoding, scaling (**fit on training only**)
- **Validation:** Subject-level split; CV; time-aware split when required
- **Explainability:** Feature importance / SHAP / partial dependence (when applicable)

## QC checklist
- **Leakage controls:** No post-baseline predictors for baseline tasks; time/order respected
- **Population consistency:** Same analysis set definition across folds/splits
- **Robustness:** Sensitivity to seeds/folds/feature sets
